name: Pet Park
hook: Adopt a pet, teach it tricks, show it off.
how: Pick and name a pet, then play fetch, feed it and teach it tricks to level it up. Show off in the park: other owners cheer your pet and you can cheer theirs. Your pet and its tricks are saved for next time.
controls: Tap or click to walk, Throw then tap the grass, tap a pet to cheer it; WASD, F to throw, E to feed, T for tricks
uses: Your pet, its name, level and tricks are saved to your player, and to this browser offline.
Bot owners walk their pets, play fetch, show off tricks and cheer yours until people arrive.
The host's browser hides bones in the grass and decides whose pet got each one; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Everyone sees every pet run, fetch and do its tricks.
The pets with the most XP.
Turn on double XP or show an event with no new deploy.
ideas: Add a dog show where pets compete with tricks
Let pets wear hats and bandanas
Add a frisbee that two pets can chase
